shared_elements: carved stone surface with inscribed/incised signs (A) and figures
justification: The only shared depicted content is the human figure: A shows a single frontal, nude, three-dimensionally modelled body standing against a slab, while B shows a low-relief file of clothed, profile attendants in procession accompanied by a large humped animal, framed above and below by rosette bands. Nothing in the relationships (procession, leading an animal, borders of floral discs) or in the frontal isolated-figure scheme of A corresponds, and the modes of depiction — rounded naturalistic volume versus flat profile relief — are also unalike.
